dedupe_keys.name: arceaux a velo de montpellier mediterranee metropole

description: Arceaux à vélo de Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole. Cette donnée renseigne l’emplacement des arceaux à vélo sur la Métropole de Montpellier. Elle est extraite automatiquement tous les dimanches d’OpenStreeMap, projet de cartographie libre et collaborative ( ). Pour information les communes de Montpellier Méditerranée Métropole contribuent désormais directement au projet OpenStreetMap ( ). Pour cette donnée les tags suivants ont été interrogés: amenity="bicycleparking". Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are parking, vélo, Montpellier. The portal shows 1,367 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-05-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
